sources.title: ParakeetAI - #1 Real-Time AI Call Assistant
sources.snippet: ParakeetAI runs in the background, knows your material, and handles the call from start to notes. Detects questions live and suggests answers, so you're never caught blank. Spots meetings as they start and asks if you want to join, with no setup mid-call.
